title: PR #64: fix(blockchain): correct validator recovery and storage lifetimes
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: False

Core fix for the CI-confirmed atc-blockchain failures. Corrects the historical validator snapshot type, preserves the latest validator snapshot API separately, restores the backward-compatible recover_state_with_dao() API expected by tests, and binds RwLock read guards before parent references. No determinism allowlist changes.
